title: X-Safe: Embodiment-Agnostic Safeguarding for Robot Arm Manipulation Policies via Action Masking
abstract: arXiv:2606.22278v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Ensuring safety of learning-enabled robotic manipulation across diverse embodiments and tasks still requires significant manual engineering. For collision avoidance, existing approaches typically rely on embodiment-specific learned safety approximations or simplified robot models together with stopping-based fallback controllers that compromise performance. In this paper, we propose an embodiment-agnostic safeguarding approach, X-Safe, which provides formal probabilistic guarantees for collision avoidance without model simplifications or learned safety functions. By operating in the configuration space, our safeguarding method works with different types of robot policies. X-Safe reasons locally around the current configuration to establish safe regions and uses action masking to restrict the policy's support to these safe regions. We demonstrate X-Safe on two embodiments and three policies, both in simulation and on hardware. W

translated_title: X-Safe：基于动作掩码的与本体无关的机械臂操作策略安全保障方法
translated_abstract: 确保基于学习的机器人操作在多样化机器人本体和任务上的安全性，仍然需要大量的手工工程。在避免碰撞方面，现有方法通常依赖于特定本体的学习型安全近似，或使用简化的机器人模型并结合基于停止的回退控制器，从而损害了系统性能。在本文中，我们提出了一种与本体无关的安全保障方法X-Safe，它能够为避免碰撞提供形式化的概率保证，而无需模型简化或学习型安全函数。通过在构型空间中运行，我们的安全保障方法可以与不同类型的机器人策略协同工作。X-Safe在当前构型附近进行局部推理以建立安全区域，并使用动作掩码将策略的动作支持范围限制在这些安全区域内。我们在两种机器人本体和三种策略上演示了X-Safe的效果，涵盖仿真和硬件实验。
tldr: X-Safe提出了一种与机器人本体无关的安全保障方法，通过在构型空间中对当前构型进行局部推理建立安全区域，并利用动作掩码将策略动作限制在安全区域内，从而在无需模型简化或学习型安全函数的情况下，为机械臂操作策略提供形式化的防碰撞概率保证。
